title: ClearFloorMod
description: Removes all blocks on the floor
body:
# **ClearFloorMod: Your Personal, Single-Player Cleaning Assistant**
Tired of constantly clearing out grass, flowers, and unwanted debris from your building sites and pathways in your personal world? ClearFloorMod is the ultimate single-player utility mod designed to automate the tedious task of floor cleaning, saving you time and effort for the more creative aspects of Minecraft. This smart mod automatically removes specific blocks from the ground level within a configurable area around you, ensuring a pristine, clear surface for your solo constructions, farms, or landscaping projects. It is important to note that ClearFloorMod is designed exclusively for Singleplayer worlds. It functions as a personal tool to enhance your individual gameplay experience without the complexities of multiplayer synchronization.

## **Key Features and Customization for Solo Play**
ClearFloorMod is built with user control in mind for your private world. Its core functionality is to scan for and remove "floor-level" blocks such as tall grass, ferns, flowers, mushrooms, saplings, and even unwanted snow layers or loose stone gravel directly around your player. The mod comes with a comprehensive in-game configuration menu, accessible via a simple command or a config file. The two most critical settings allow you to toggle the mod on or off instantly, making it easy to preserve areas you don't want to be cleared. Secondly, you can adjust the removal interval, determining how often (in seconds) the mod scans for blocks. Set it to a low number for instant, continuous cleaning as you walk, or a higher number for occasional, performance-friendly sweeps.

### **Why Singleplayer-Only and How It Enhances Your Solo Gameplay**
The decision to make ClearFloorMod single-player only is intentional, focusing on stability and simplicity. In multiplayer, synchronizing block removal for all players, handling permissions, and preventing conflicts would require a completely different, more complex architecture, often necessitating the mod to be installed on the server side. By being a client-side mod for single-player, it ensures reliable, lag-free operation directly in your world. This makes it a perfect companion for creative builders, meticulous landscapers, and survival players who want to manage their environment efficiently. Before laying down intricate floor designs or creating large-scale farms in your personal world, simply activate ClearFloorMod to gain a perfectly blank canvas. It’s the dedicated, automated janitor for your solo adventures, eliminating mundane repetition so you can focus purely on your own creativity and exploration.
